## Overview

What `provideMovement()` accepts: any subset of [`MovementConfig`](/docs/reference/movement-config-interface), with `duration` and
`delay` taking a [`MoveTime`](/docs/reference/move-time) (`320`, `'320ms'`, `'0.32s'`). The injected
`MOVEMENT_CONFIG` is always normalized to numeric milliseconds.

Stable API — covered by semantic-versioning guarantees.

- **Kind:** Type alias
- **Stability:** `stable`

## Definition

```ts
type MovementConfigInput = Partial<Omit<MovementConfig, 'duration' | 'delay'>> & {
  duration?: MoveTime;
  delay?: MoveTime;
};
```
